- [USER] User asked for tips or strategies for writing a standout personal statement to increase chances of acceptance into the Master's programme at Oxford.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for writing a standout personal statement include starting with a strong opening, showcasing academic background, demonstrating research interests, showing enthusiasm, drawing on relevant experience, being specific, and being concise.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The personal statement should be no longer than two A4 pages and should be proofread for errors.
